agents.name: product_researcher
agents.purpose: Verify product capabilities, enterprise requirements and upstream reuse options.
triggers: New product capability proposal
A product brief or source claim needs fresh evidence
agents.write_scope: Assigned research paths only; otherwise return findings without edits

agents.name: architect
agents.purpose: Resolve a bounded design decision using current implementation and reuse evidence.
triggers: A proposed change crosses an architectural boundary
An accepted issue needs interfaces or a migration decision
inputs: Existing code, deployment constraints and ADRs

agents.name: implementer
agents.purpose: Implement an accepted issue in its owning repository.
triggers: An issue has an agreed outcome, acceptance criteria and file ownership
agents.write_scope: Only implementation and test paths explicitly assigned for the issue

agents.name: verifier
agents.purpose: Independently prove or challenge each completion claim at the claimed scope.
triggers: An implementation is ready for review
A deployment or release is claimed complete
outputs: Criterion-by-criterion proven, contradicted or unverified report
agents.write_scope: Assigned verification report paths only; no implementation edits

agents.name: triage_manager
agents.purpose: Turn incoming reports into reproducible, deduplicated and actionable work.
triggers: Maintainer requests an inbox review
A new issue needs scope, reproduction or dependency analysis
outputs: Acceptance criteria and suggested next owner
agents.write_scope: Assigned triage report paths; issue mutations require task authorization

agents.name: docs_maintainer
agents.purpose: Maintain truthful, task-oriented documentation and the documentation site.
triggers: A behavior or configuration change affects users
A documentation route or link fails
A release candidate needs version-specific guidance
agents.write_scope: Assigned docs and site source paths; deployment requires task authorization

agents.name: release_manager
agents.purpose: Prepare release candidates and operational evidence for independent verification.
triggers: A milestone reaches its defined release criteria
Maintainer requests a release readiness assessment
inputs: Product release criteria and release-readiness skill
outputs: Candidate manifest and draft release notes
agents.write_scope: Assigned release documents or packaging paths; publishing requires task authorization

agents.name: security_reviewer
agents.purpose: Independently review security boundaries, dependencies and delivery trust.
triggers: A change affects authorization, credentials, untrusted execution or CI permissions
A release candidate needs security review
An authorized private vulnerability investigation is assigned
inputs: Threat scenario and allowed test environment
outputs: Findings with severity, reproduction and impact
agents.write_scope: Assigned review artifacts only; undisclosed findings stay in approved private destinations

agents.name: portfolio_steward
agents.purpose: Keep the portfolio registry and operational links consistent with observed reality.
triggers: Maintainer requests a portfolio review
A registered repository, service or agent changes
Release evidence supports a maturity update
inputs: Named registered repositories and audit date
Registry files and authorized read-only API state
outputs: Maintenance ticket drafts and role handoffs
agents.write_scope: Assigned umbrella registry and operations paths; no product implementation edits
